headline.caveat: MGX's individual check is undisclosed. It co-led OpenAI's $122B round (closed Mar 31, 2026, $852B post-money) from its $49B AI fund (closed Jul 1, 2026), alongside NVIDIA ($30B), Amazon ($50B), and SoftBank ($30B).

realized_to_date.caveat: Funded at the round's close; amount not broken out. MGX also holds earlier OpenAI exposure (2024 round, Stargate JV equity).

nature_md: Abu Dhabi's MGX co-led OpenAI's $122B round (closed Mar 31, 2026 at $852B post-money) with an undisclosed commitment from its $49B dedicated AI fund — the largest sovereign AI vehicle on record. MGX is OpenAI's most consequential sovereign backer across multiple layers: direct equity (2024 and 2026 rounds), Stargate LLC JV equity, and Stargate UAE infrastructure. Its H1-2026 run also included co-leads in Anthropic's $30B round and xAI's $20B Series E — one state fund holding equity in all three frontier labs simultaneously.

accounting.payer_treatment_md: MGX books a private-market equity position at fund level (state fund; no public accounts). Its cross-lab portfolio means correlated mark-to-market exposure to the entire frontier-lab asset class.
accounting.payee_treatment_md: OpenAI books equity financing — no revenue, no liability; sovereign proceeds co-fund the compute purchases (Oracle, AWS, Stargate) recognized as revenue across its supplier base.

both_sides_md: **Bull:** patient sovereign capital with 30-year horizons is the natural holder of pre-IPO frontier-lab equity, and Gulf capital comes bundled with power-rich land for inference buildout. **Bear:** undisclosed check sizes from state funds concentrated across all three rival labs blur price discovery — round marks set partly by strategic (non-financial) buyers are weak evidence of value.

events.title: MGX closes $49B AI fund after co-leading OpenAI's $122B round
